verdict.rationale: Quo documents in-product AI output from user data: recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, and AI call tags are listed as a plan feature. Its home page also claims to help 'spot issues', though it does not say how. The MCP-based summaries run in external agents such as Claude, so they don't count as in-product, and nothing documents AI-generated suggestions or recommendations. Missing for 10: documented AI suggestions or recommendations, cross-data insights or analytics beyond per-call summaries and tags, detailed docs on how the insights work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
